title: Understanding the Effect of Substrate Preheating Temperature and Track Spacing on Laser Assisted Cold Spraying of Ti6Al4V
InformationInFigures: Yes. cold spray spot diameter (Fig. 2a), Hardness values (Fig. 10)

experimentalProperties.Additional_Manufacturing_Processes_Descr: Microhardness was according to ASTM E384. For metallographic examination, samples were prepared using a standard metallographic specimen preparation procedure comprising cross-sectioning, mounting, and grinding with SiC abrasive paper discs up to 2500 grit size; followed by polishing with OP-U colloidal silica suspension

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: presence of partially deformed ‘textured’ regions (residue of α’ martensite phase inherited from the feedstock powder) and severely deformed ‘smooth’ regions.  presence of fully equiaxed microstructure

experimentalProperties.Deposit_Post_Treatment_Description: Solution treatment and ageing in a vacuum condition at 940°C for 1h then argon fast cooling, then aging for 8h at 480°C followed by furnace cooling to room temp (20-25°C)
